fixedVariants: WORLDFIXED/WARFIXED are the fixture-fixed pair (VITUSFIXED/H2OFIXED deploy inside their constructors); ENCRYPT/GWAT are verbatim. The app ABIs are the WORLD/WAR interfaces; the deployed names in the runtime overlay stay WORLD/WAR.

variants.ENCRYPT: verbatim (self-registers as VOID's 'encrypt' library in its constructor)
variants.WORLDFIXED: fixture-fixed WORLD (+ VITUSFIXED inside): the verbatim constructor callback loop is patched; the cauda write is wired
variants.WARFIXED: fixture-fixed WAR (+ H2OFIXED inside): the verbatim constructor callback loop is patched
variants.GWAT: verbatim (read-only constructor against the live perimeter + WAR)
